services.name: Book A Charter
services.desc: Booking will require a deposit of $200 received within 10 days of booking to hold date. In the event of inclement weather the trip will be rescheduled. Cancelling based on weather is Captain’s decision and will be based on safety! A 4% fee added if Credit Card is used for payment Full refund if notified 30 days in advance or a cancellation based off weather a refund check will be issued* Fishing License, rain coat, drinks, snacks or lunches, sunblock, non marking shoes, camera, and a cooler to take fish home
